scientific_integrity: All mathematical claims are supported by an explicit backward-resolvent and two-state spectral argument; finite numerical checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Only a single half-line Brownian searcher with strictly positive diffusivity, reset rate, two autonomous target switching rates and reset position; target initially stationary; count of resets before capture. No arbitrary initial-gate or multistate extension, no asserted joint time/count law. Literature priority is subject to independent assessment.
title: Two-geometric reset counts and strictly decreasing capture hazards at a fluctuating target
